intent_summary: The anomaly-detection Skill offers an explicitly requested quick chart or a detailed figure specification after structured analysis completes.

criteria.criterion: The Skill defaults to text and requires an explicit visualization request; quick charts and publication-quality figures have separate instructions.
criteria.notes: The Skill explicitly requires a visual request after analysis and separates quick versus detailed rendering instructions.

criteria.criterion: The dependency-free quick chart fallback renders one resolved dataset's observed values and available expectations, marks only triggered evidence, and labels training, calibration, units, and reviewed reset boundaries.
criteria.notes: Real-result tests establish observed/expected lines, trigger-only markers, provisional non-triggering, units, initialization shading, and reset boundaries; the spike chart was inspected visually.

criteria.criterion: The fallback rejects unsupported multi-dataset results and protects an existing output file unless overwrite is explicitly requested.
criteria.notes: Multiple resolved datasets raise a specific error. The CLI test preserves an existing chart and replaces it only with explicit overwrite.

criteria.criterion: Detailed figure instructions preserve source indices, provisional-versus-calibrated evidence, pattern detection timing, and incomplete or failed run status, without presenting scores as probabilities or flags as proven causes.
criteria.notes: Detailed instructions require index alignment, maturity distinctions, first detection timing, visible unavailable status, and qualified causal claims; native interactive rendering remains host-dependent.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
Skill criteria covering agent instructions are supported by the written guidance and demonstrated tool workflow; cross-host agent compliance and real-world detection accuracy are not asserted.
